LEGACY_SUPPLIER_ERP.Name: LEGACY_SUPPLIER_ERP
LEGACY_SUPPLIER_ERP.Description: Legacy on-prem supplier master system. ProxyType=OnPremise means that in a real BTP landscape this destination is only reachable through Cloud Connector's secure tunnel from inside the customer's network — the app never talks to the on-prem system directly. Simulated here as a direct localhost call since there's no real on-prem network segment to tunnel to from a laptop; see srv/lib/destination.js for exactly where the real SAP Destination service call would replace this file.
